description.message: Open Deezer links in the desktop app instead of the browser.

lang.description: Language of the pages, for the lang attribute.

movingTitle.description: Title of the page opened once when Deezer Link is updated.

movingIntro.message: Deezer Link will no longer be updated. Music Bridge, from the same developer, does everything it does: it opens Deezer links in the desktop app. And more: it opens the links of Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music and other platforms on Deezer too.

movingInstallButton.description: Link to Music Bridge in the store.

movingSettingsStep.message: In its options, choose Deezer, then tick "Open links in the desktop app" (and, if you like, "Close the tab once the app opens").
movingSettingsStep.description: Second step: the Music Bridge options to set.

movingUninstallButton.description: Button removing Deezer Link, after the browser asks.

movingMeanwhile.message: Until then, Deezer Link steps aside on the pages Music Bridge opens: the desktop app does not open twice.
movingMeanwhile.description: Note at the end of the moving page.

movingNewTab.description: Read by assistive technologies after the store link: it opens a new tab, so that the moving page stays open for the last step.
